hunks.baseline: Even if we couldn’t see each other, we knew each other too well.

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord convulsed with pain the likes of which he’d never imagined.

hunks.sol: I could feel all the pain and hatred in the North Heaven Demon Lord’s voice as he ground the words out through teeth clenched hard enough to draw blood.

hunks.baseline: It didn’t know.

hunks.sol: But as the years passed and the intervals between its awakenings grew shorter, it had begun to realize something.

hunks.sol: The day it had thought it would never reach was now close at hand.

hunks.sol: It extinguished the torches that faintly lit the thick darkness and shook the ground and roof.

hunks.sol: That sudden upheaval, like great waves rising on a tranquil lake, was proof that the being in the darkness had realized why it had opened its eyes.
